description_en: Creates a model service that allows AI functions to invoke models. You can create a service for two types of models: a model from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio or a model on a Hologres AI node. If you use a Hologres AI node, you must purchase the AI node resources separately
description_zh: 创建模型服务，支持AI function调用模型。支持创建两类模型：1）阿里云百炼模型；2）Hologres AI节点。如果是Hologres AI，需要另外购买AI节点资源
name: CreateModelService

parameters.help_en: The API key for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. This parameter is required only for Model Studio models. You can obtain this key from the Model Studio console or by calling an API
parameters.help_zh: 百炼API Key，请登陆百炼控制台或通过API获取。此参数仅百炼模型需要
parameters.name: api_key

parameters.help_en: The number of vCPUs. This parameter is required only for a Hologres AI node
parameters.help_zh: CPU，此参数仅Hologres AI节点需要
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The number of GPUs. This parameter is required only for a Hologres AI node
parameters.help_zh: GPU规格，此参数仅Hologres AI节点需要
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.help_en: The GPU memory size in GB. This parameter is required only for a Hologres AI node
parameters.help_zh: GPU 内存规格，此参数仅 Hologres AI 节点需要
parameters.name: gpu_memory

parameters.help_en: The memory size in GB. This parameter is required only for a Hologres AI node
parameters.help_zh: 内存规格，此参数仅Hologres AI节点需要
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The model parameters, required only for Model Studio models. You can provide the default parameters returned by the `ListModelCatalog` operation or a modified version of them
parameters.help_zh: 模型参数，请参考ListModelCatalog返回的默认参数，直接传入，有必要则修改后再传入。此参数仅百炼模型需要
parameters.name: model_params

parameters.help_en: A custom name for the model service
parameters.name: model_service_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the model. To find the name, call `ListModelCatalog` for a model from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, or `GetAvailableModelsResource` for a model on a Hologres AI node
parameters.help_zh: 模型名称。如果是百炼模型，请调用ListModelCatalog查询；如果是Hologres AI节点，请调用GetAvailableModelsResource查询
parameters.name: model_type

parameters.help_en: The provider of the underlying model
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The number of replicas. This parameter is required only for a Hologres AI node
parameters.help_zh: 服务副本数，此参数仅 Hologres AI 节点需要
parameters.name: service_count

parameters.help_en: The type of task the model performs, such as `chat/completions` or `embedding`. To find the supported task types, see the output of the `ListModelCatalog` operation
parameters.help_zh: 模型类型，比如chat/completions，embedding。请参考ListModelCatalog返回的类型，按需创建
parameters.name: task_type

data.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. A value of `true` indicates success, and `false` indicates failure
